clue.text: If cutting classes, schools may be turned into these occasionally

definitions.text: If cutting classes, schools may be turned into these occasionally

blocks.clueFragment: If cutting classes, schools may be turned into these occasionally
blocks.note: surface reading: truanting pupils turning their school into some sort of den now and then
setter's reading: on election day lessons are cancelled because many school halls become places where people vote

explanation.surface: A worry that skipping lessons might turn schools into something else from time to time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cutting classes' suggests truancy, but it is the school closing for the day so the public can come in and cast votes.
explanation.definitionFit: On election days British school buildings are often requisitioned as the places where voters cast their ballots.
